apps.name: Pick the Menu
apps.tagline: Five quick questions. One nearby restaurant, open now.
apps.summary: A mobile web app that settles “where should we eat?” Five quick questions return one nearby restaurant that’s open now.
function: A five-step quiz (vibe, cravings, hunger, distance, location) narrows nearby options to a single pick.
Group mode lets friends decide together.
Past picks are saved on the device.
apps.approach: Phone-first and account-free. Location is used only for the search, group links expire after a day, and email backup is optional.
